verdict_summary: A large, good-faith rewrite: 13 of 17 changes landed, 8 of 14 gates are met, and the two hardest changes (the byte-integrity mandate at §4 and the per-folder count floors with the anti-curation rule at §3) are present and in force. INSUFFICIENT for four reasons, three of them created by the rewrite: (1) §3's interval-run rule now contradicts §4 and §8a and is impossible in three of the six folders — half of every modern folder is specified by a rule the document elsewhere forbids obeying; (2) §8a states no numeric rejection thresholds, defines upscale_test circularly, and the §9 exemplar record carries a nyq_ratio that §8a says is grounds for rejection; (3) §8b was downgraded from a commit gate to a label ('single-source images are kept but flagged'), turning off the only check that catches a competently generated landscape; (4) the §10 stop condition was inverted from an anti-padding abort rule into a completion rule, so nothing now forbids padding a shortfall with degraded copies. All fixes are paragraph-sized; no restructuring is required.

new_defects.title: §3's interval-run rule contradicts §4 and §8a, and is impossible in three of the six folders
new_defects.detail: §3 requires at least half of every modern folder (30 of the 60 images) to come from 'one continuous gameplay video or one continuous screenshot series' sampled at fixed intervals. By video: extracting a frame means encoding a new file, which breaks rule 1 and §4, and the frames carry inter-frame codec artefacts that §5b itself declares invalid for texture and anti-aliasing statistics and that §8a would reject on nyq_ratio and block_score — half of every modern folder would be rejected by the prompt's own script. v1's guard sentence ('a still extracted from a clip must never be placed in refs/modern/') was dropped in the rewrite. By screenshot series: an unbiased run cannot produce material_closeup ('one surface filling the frame' is a selected shot by definition), cannot reliably produce character_closeup at >=40% of frame height (over-the-shoulder gameplay puts the character at 25-35%), and cannot be relied on for combat. Four of the eight images in the material_closeup floor are specified as something that does not exist.

new_defects.title: The stop condition was inverted; nothing forbids padding a shortfall
new_defects.detail: Rank 15's abort rule became a completion rule. With an over-scoped ask and §8b now permitting uncorroborated images ('kept but flagged'), the cheapest path to a PASS count table is to pad the last slots of each folder with re-hosted, promotional or single-source images. That is precisely the failure BAR-CRITIQUE-IMAGES-01 was written about: a complete-looking set with a degraded quarter we cannot identify afterwards.

new_defects.title: §8a states no numeric thresholds, upscale_test is unimplementable, and the §9 exemplar contradicts §8a's own rejection rule
new_defects.detail: 'Near zero', 'high' and 'flags an image enlarged' are not thresholds, so 'flag and move to rejected/' cannot be executed. upscale_test is defined as 'ratio of high-frequency energy to what the stated resolution implies', which is circular — the stated resolution implies nothing measurable. And the §9 exemplar, a 2560x1440 PNG at 9.1 bpp (i.e. a pristine file), records nyq_ratio: 0.031, which under §8a ('any with a nyq_ratio near zero in refs/modern/') is grounds for rejection. An agent copying the exemplar produces a manifest its own script disagrees with.

new_defects.title: §8b corroboration downgraded from a commit gate to a label
new_defects.detail: v1: first-party / two-hosts / pre-2023-page, and 'an image satisfying none of the three is not committed'. v2: "two-hosts" | "one-host" | "none", and 'single-source images are kept but flagged'. This is the only check in the document that catches a competently generated landscape, because such an image looks correct and has no history — which is exactly what 'corroboration: none' records while still admitting the file. Losing first-party also means a publisher's own store-page screenshot, the best provenance available, must be logged as the weak value one-host.

new_defects.title: The triage line was cut from the priority block
new_defects.detail: 'If you run out of time or budget, satisfy rules 1-5 on fewer slots rather than rules 6-10 on more' is gone. Given the scope this run will be partial, and the document no longer says what to sacrifice. An agent short on budget will thin every folder evenly — six folders each just under their floor calibrate nothing.

new_defects.title: REF-M17 contradicts its own folder definition
new_defects.detail: §2 defines interior_darkemissive as 'caves and interiors lit mainly by emissive sources'; REF-M17 is 'a cave or ruin interior lit by a daylight shaft'. Only two slots feed a floor of ten, so up to half that folder could be daylight-lit interiors — a different lighting regime inside a per-profile band. It would inflate the p10-p90 spread of M1 and M6 for that profile with variance that has nothing to do with rendering, the exact error §6 forbids one paragraph later.

new_defects.title: REF-M19 lost the clause that justified the slot
new_defects.detail: 'A shoreline / shallow water edge where water meets land' is a photograph anyone would take. The slot existed because the water metric compares grazing-angle and steep-downward water inside a single frame, which requires a low camera close to the surface. As written M19 duplicates M4 with less mist.

Overcast noon is our declared default weather — the lighting condition the game spends most of its time in — and it is now a parenthetical inside a row about god rays.

demand.plus: make-manifest.py implementing FFT, EXIF, C2PA and JPEG quantisation-table analysis; a 130-170-record manifest; a five-section report

feasibility.reasoning: Every image additionally needs a full-size original located and downloaded, a two-host corroboration search, three named identifying features, and — for the ~50 Morrowind files — seven vanilla tests recorded individually. That is three to five distinct web operations per file, i.e. 400-700 operations, before the script is written. The predicted outcome is a thin version of everything, which is worse than a complete version of the essentials, and worse still here because a folder at 60% of its floor produces a band that looks computed and is not.

remaining_changes.target: §3, the paragraph beginning '**The anti-curation rule — read this twice.**' through '...one magnificent one.'; plus priority rule 5
remaining_changes.replacement_text:
**The anti-curation rule — read this twice.** It applies to three folders only: `exterior_daylight`, `exterior_lowlight` and `interior_darkemissive`. In each of those, **at least half** the images must come from an *unbiased run*: pick one continuous **native screenshot series** — a Steam screenshot showcase, an imgur or Flickr album, a gallery upload set from a single play session — and take every Nth image **regardless of whether the frame is attractive**. Skip a sampled image only if it is a menu, cutscene, loading screen, HUD-covered, or almost entirely black. Name these `run-<source-slug>-<index>.<ext>` and set `"sampling": "interval-run"`. The rest may be deliberately chosen and are marked `"sampling": "selected"`.

**Never extract a frame from a video into `refs/modern/`.** Extracting a frame means encoding a new file, which breaks §4, and every frame of a compressed video carries codec artefacts that §8a rejects. Video lives in `refs/video/` and is measured for motion only, never for texture, anti-aliasing or colour.

`character_closeup`, `combat` and `material_closeup` are **exempt** from the interval-run rule: an unbiased run cannot produce a surface filling the frame or a character at 40% of frame height. remaining_changes.replacement_text:
nyq_ratio        = 2-D FFT of the luminance channel; energy in radial frequency
                   [0.45,0.50) divided by energy in [0.20,0.45). A native capture
                   typically lands in 0.05-0.30. **Below 0.02 in refs/modern/ means the
                   image was downscaled or blurred and its real edge detail is gone.**
upscale_test     = box-downsample the luminance to 2/3 size, bilinear-upsample it back
                   to the original size, take the mean absolute difference in 0..1
                   luminance. A native capture typically lands in 0.01-0.05.
                   **Below 0.004 means the image carries no detail at its stated
                   resolution: it was enlarged from a smaller original.**
block_score      = mean |horizontal gradient| across 8-pixel-aligned column boundaries
                   divided by the same across non-aligned boundaries. Native or lightly
                   compressed: 0.95-1.10. **Above 1.15 means JPEG block artefacts are
                   visible in the pixels we measure.**

Move to `rejected/`: any file with `upscale_test < 0.004`; any `refs/modern/` file with `nyq_ratio < 0.02`; any file with `block_score > 1.15` (unless nothing better exists for that slot, in which case keep it and set `"heavily_recompressed": true`); any file whose `exif_software` names an editor (Photoshop, GIMP, ImageMagick, "Save for Web") or a generative tool; any file with `c2pa_present` or AI-generator metadata. Record every rejection and its failing statistic in the rejection log.
